chunks: From him, from Safwan, from Mu‘allā ibn ‘Uthmān, from Mu‘allā ibn Khunays, from Abī ‘Abdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
The end of the time of al-‘atamah is midnight.

key_terms.وَقْتِ: the prescribed time of an act of worship

ai.seo_question: Until what time does the ‘isha prayer remain valid according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling regarding the time for the ‘isha prayer, referred to here as al-‘atamah. It establishes that the end of its time is at midnight, indicating a limit for performing the prayer within its prescribed period.
